candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory reservation failures (503), order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; underlying cause of redis timeout (load, saturation, network) not established.

report.explanation: Checkout POSTs return 502 after ~2s. Traces show gateway->order ReadTimeout, order->inventory ReadTimeout, and inventory->redis reserve_inventory timeout (DependencyUnavailable). Topology confirms inventory depends on redis. Bounded root cause: redis timeout on inventory reservation path.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics and logs for reserve_inventory during incident window
